WITH filtered_users AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, u.email, u.status, u.is_active,
         u.is_verified, u.created_at, u.updated_at
  FROM n_users u
  WHERE (:user_id IS NULL OR u.user_id = :user_id) AND (:status IS NULL OR u.status = :status)
    AND (:q IS NULL OR INSTR(LOWER(u.username), LOWER(:q)) > 0
      OR INSTR(LOWER(u.display_name), LOWER(:q)) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(u.email), LOWER(:q)) > 0)
), report_targets AS (
  SELECT m.target_id AS user_id FROM n_moderation_reports m WHERE m.target_type = 'user'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.author_id AS user_id FROM n_moderation_reports m JOIN n_posts p ON p.post_id = m.target_id
  WHERE m.target_type = 'post'
), report_counts AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count FROM report_targets GROUP BY user_id
), ranked_users AS (
  SELECT f.*, NVL(m.report_count, 0) AS report_count
  FROM filtered_users f LEFT JOIN report_counts m ON m.user_id = f.user_id
), numbered AS (
  SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY
     CASE WHEN :sort = 'reports' THEN r.report_count END DESC,
     CASE WHEN :sort = 'oldest' THEN r.created_at END ASC,
     CASE WHEN :sort <> 'oldest' THEN r.created_at END DESC,
     CASE WHEN :sort = 'oldest' THEN r.user_id END ASC,
     r.user_id DESC
  ) AS rn FROM ranked_users r
), page_users AS (
  SELECT * FROM numbered WHERE rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
), restrictions AS (
  SELECT r.user_id, r.restriction_type, r.ends_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY r.user_id ORDER BY r.starts_at DESC, r.restriction_id DESC
  ) AS rn
  FROM n_moderation_user_restrictions r JOIN page_users p ON p.user_id = r.user_id
  WHERE r.status = 'active' AND r.starts_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (r.ends_at IS NULL OR r.ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT p.user_id, p.username, p.display_name, p.avatar_url, p.email, p.status, p.is_active, p.is_verified,
       NVL(s.followers_count, 0) AS followers_count, NVL(s.posts_count, 0) AS posts_count, NVL(s.likes_count, 0) AS likes_count,
       p.report_count, r.restriction_type AS active_restriction,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.ends_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS restriction_until,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(p.created_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS created_at,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(p.updated_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at,
       t.total
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM filtered_users) t
LEFT JOIN page_users p ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN n_user_stats s ON s.user_id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN restrictions r ON r.user_id = p.user_id AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.rn
